escenas.texto: Which was the most commented video in Europe this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, DİKENLİ KASK GERİ DÖNDÜ! FULLENMİŞ AKM ve VAMPİR SETİ!…, by Vural Üzül, with over 14 thousand comments.
In second place, How Indian Media BRAINWASHES You! | Dhruv Rathee, by Dhruv Rathee, with over 25 thousand comments.
And number one: President Zelenskyy: It's Time To Tell You The Truth…, by The Diary Of A CEO, with over 45 thousand comments.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
